decision.explanation: Document D1S3 explicitly states that Guerin High School was established in 1962 as Mother Theodore Guerin High School. This is further supported by D3S4, which confirms that Guerin Prep was founded as an all-girls school in 1962. The claim of 1963 in D2S7 refers to when classes began in the new building, not the establishment of the school itself. Therefore, 1962 is the correct and only valid answer.
